name: Shipley Center for Innovation at Clarkson University

description.text: Clarkson University's Shipley Center for Innovation helps guide entrepreneurs and inventors as they bring their ideas to life.

targetApplicants.text: Through a collaborative, hands-on process, the Shipley Center provides inventors and entrepreneurs with the resources and expertise needed to fully commercialize their products and launch successful new businesses.
